task: Compare available plans for the AeroAPI on Flightaware.
agent_final_answer:
AeroAPI on FlightAware offers 3 plans/tiers: Personal, Standard, and Premium.

PURPOSE / OVERVIEW
- Personal: Storage and distribution of derivative works for personal or academic purposes only.
- Standard: For business or business-to-consumer purposes. Everything in Personal plus historical data, flight alerting, and email support.
- Premium: For business, B2C, and all B2B commercial purposes. Everything in Standard plus advanced data sets (Aireon space-based ADS-B), Foresight Predictions, and enterprise-grade services with both email and phone support.

FEATURE / API COMPARISON (Personal | Standard | Premium)
- Alerts: No | Yes | Yes
- FlightAware Foresight*: No | No | Yes
- Aireon Space-Based ADS-B*: No | No | Yes
- Historical Flight Data: No | Yes | Yes
- Static maps and imagery: Yes | Yes | Yes

PRICING DETAILS
- Pricing model: per-query usage fees for all tiers. Personal includes up to $5 free per month (or $10 free per month for ADS-B feeders); Standard and Premium per-query fees are subject to a monthly minimum.
- Monthly minimum fee: No minimum | $100/month | $1,000/month
- Result set rate limit: 10 result sets/minute | 5 result sets/second | 100 result sets/second
- History result set rate limit: N/A | 500,000 result sets/month | 500,000 result sets/month
- Volume Discounting: No | Yes | Yes

AUTHORIZED USERS / LICENSE
- Internal Use for Business: No | Yes | Yes
- Commercialization B2C: No | Yes | Yes
- Commercialization B2B: No | No | Yes
- Internal Use for Personal: Yes | Yes | Yes
- Academic: Yes | Yes | Yes

GENERAL / SUPPORT
- Up-time guarantee: No | No | 99.5%
- Email Support: No | Yes | Yes
- Phone Support: No | No | Yes
- Invoicing Available: No | No | Yes

Note: * Foresight and Aireon Space-Based ADS-B require contacting FlightAware to enable, and some usage restrictions apply. Standard and Premium tiers are also eligible for volume discounting (the first $1,000/month is billed at list price, with discounts up to 94% off for monthly usage above $64,000).
